title: Looking for a mentor to help me learn AI trading
author: 8a8atund3
selftext:
Hey everyone, I’m a recent graduate trying to figure out a realistic way to build a sustainable income. I’ve been looking into AI-assisted trading and would really like to learn from someone who actually has experience with it.  
I’m not looking for anyone to manage money for me or promising to get rich quickly. I’d just appreciate having a genuine mentor who can put me on the right track, explain how things work, and walk me through the basics as I learn. I’d rather learn properly from someone experienced than end up falling for some trading scam or wasting money on random courses.  
If anyone here is experienced and willing to mentor a beginner, I’d really appreciate hearing from you.

comments.author: mojovski
